domain: Oil & Gas and Infrastructure EPC Project Management

piping.definition: Prefabricated segment of a piping system comprising pipes, flanges, and fittings welded together in a workshop before site erection.
Pressure testing of piping circuits or vessels using water to verify mechanical integrity and leak-tightness at specified design test pressures.
Non-destructive testing (NDT) method using X-rays or gamma rays to inspect internal weld quality for volumetric defects like porosity or lack of fusion.
Non-destructive testing technique using high-frequency sound waves to detect sub-surface flaws in pipe welds and measure wall thickness.
Alignment and temporary tacking of adjacent pipe ends with correct root gap, bevel angle, and high-low tolerance prior to full root run welding.
Reinforced branch fittings welded directly to header pipes including Weldolet, Sockolet, and Thredolet connections.
Controlled tightening of flange bolts using calibrated torque wrenches or hydraulic bolt tensioners to ensure leak-proof joint compression.
Insertion of spectacle blinds, spade blinds, or spacer rings into flange joints to physically isolate lines during maintenance or commissioning.
Controlled thermal cycle applied to welded joints to relieve residual stresses and restore metallurgical ductility in alloy or thick steel pipes.
Lifting and laying process and utility pipe spools onto elevated multi-tier structural pipe racks and securing onto pipe shoes.
Final connection point between a newly constructed pipeline network and an existing operational header or battery limit.
Detailed 3D single-line shop drawing indicating exact pipe dimensions, coordinates, weld numbers, and Bill of Materials for fabrication.
Propelling mechanical pigs through buried or cross-country pipelines to clean debris, dewater, or verify bore clearance using caliper pigs.
Attaching steam supply tubes or outer jackets along process piping to maintain temperature and prevent fluid solidification or condensation.
Electrochemical corrosion protection for buried cross-country pipelines and tank bottoms using sacrificial anodes or impressed current (ICCP).
High-voltage spark testing along external anti-corrosion pipeline coating (3LPE / FBE) to detect pinholes, voids, or micro-cracks before trench lowering.
Excavating right-of-way trenches, laying soft sand padding, and using side-booms to lower welded pipeline strings into position.
Tapping into live pressurized piping or pipelines using special drilling machines without shutting down operational flow.
Calibrated precision straight piping spool fitted with orifice flange taps for differential pressure flow measurement.
Structural guides, anchors, clamps, and variable spring hangers installed to restrain thermal expansion and support pipe operating weight.
Trenchless pipeline crossing method under rivers, roads, and railways by drilling a pilot hole, reaming, and pulling pipeline strings.
Injecting dry gaseous nitrogen into completed piping systems to displace air/oxygen and moisture prior to hydrocarbon introduction.
Full penetration circumferential groove weld joining two beveled pipe ends per ASME B31.3.
Fillet welded pipe attachment inserted into recessed fitting with 1.5mm expansion gap.
Metallic winding with graphite or PTFE filler ring inserted between raised face flanges.
Figure-8 steel plate comprising an open orifice ring and solid blind disk for line isolation.
Forming smooth radius turns (3D/5D) in long pipelines using induction heating or cold bending machines.

civil.definition: Bulk soil cutting, pit excavation, and trenching to reach designated formation level for equipment foundations and buried utilities.
Non-structural lean concrete blinding layer (M10/M15 grade) cast on soil to provide a clean, level surface for rebar placement.
Structural concrete embedded with deformed steel rebar (TMT bars) capable of withstanding heavy tensile and compressive loads.
Cutting, bending, and placing Thermo-Mechanically Treated (TMT) high-yield steel bars tied with binding wire per bar bending schedules.
Temporary steel or plywood moulds and staging props erected to contain freshly placed concrete until it attains self-supporting strength.
Massive continuous reinforced concrete slab foundation spreading heavy equipment loads across the entire footprint.
Bored cast-in-situ concrete piles drilled deep into hard strata topped with reinforced pile caps for heavy structure support.
Reinforced horizontal concrete beam cast at ground level connecting isolated pedestals to prevent differential settlement.
Mechanical roller compaction of soil layers verified by sand replacement or core cutter tests for target Proctor density (e.g. 95% MDD).
Filling excavated trenches and foundation gaps with selected granular soil in compacted 200mm layers.
Sampling ready-mix concrete for slump workability and curing 150mm test cubes for 7-day and 28-day compressive strength checks.
Pouring high-strength flowable non-shrink grout under equipment base plates and structural column pedestals.
Construction of precast or cast-in-situ open concrete drains, box culverts, and catch pits for plant surface runoff control.
Heavy reinforced concrete or profiled steel barrier designed to protect control rooms and substations from overpressure waves.
Elevated concrete plinths cast above foundation slabs to support rotating equipment, pumps, and structural columns.
Assembly and crane hoisting of structural steel columns, beams, bracing members, and purlins for process structures.
Fixing high-tensile foundation bolt clusters into formwork using rigid steel templates prior to concreting.
High Strength Friction Grip structural bolt tensioning using direct tension indicators or calibrated torque multipliers.
Installation of profiled color-coated galvalume metal sheets and polycarbonate skylights on industrial shed roofs and walls.
Application of dense cementitious or intumescent fireproofing layers onto structural steel columns up to designated height limits.
Lowering groundwater table during foundation excavation using wellpoint headers or submersible sump pumps.
Laying Wet Mix Macadam (WMM) and bituminous asphalt concrete paving for internal plant access roads.
Installation of factory-cast concrete U-troughs and precast cover slabs for substation cable routing.
Erecting chain-link security fencing, razor wire coils, or precast concrete compound walls.
Sealing building and road expansion gaps with polysulphide sealants, backer rods, and waterstops.

static_rotating.definition: Mounting, shimming, and leveling API 610 horizontal and vertical centrifugal pumps on fabricated steel skids or concrete plinths.
Precision positioning and anchoring of high-pressure multi-stage reciprocating gas compressors, crankcases, and pulsation dampeners.
Rigging and placing heavy TEMA shell and tube heat exchangers onto saddle supports and installing tube bundles.
Erecting elevated air cooler tube bundles, plenums, fan motors, drive belts, and louvers on structural piperacks.
Heavy tandem crane lifting, vertical tailing, and skirt anchoring of massive refinery fractionating towers and stripping columns.
Positioning horizontal or vertical ASME Sec VIII pressure vessels, knock-out drums, and flash drums onto foundations.
Laying bottom annular plates, jacking curved shell courses, and assembling floating or cone roofs for large crude oil storage tanks.
Erecting pressurized spherical petal plates supported on tubular legs for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) storage.
Precision measuring of rim and face runout and cold/hot offset between driver (motor/turbine) and driven shafts using laser tools.
High-velocity thermal cycling and filtration of lube oil through rotating machinery bearings to meet ISO particle count cleanliness specs.
Fitting cartridge mechanical seals with flush piping plans (Plan 53, Plan 11) onto pump stuffing boxes.
Internal bolting of valve trays, sieve trays, structured packing, liquid distributors, and demister pads inside distillation columns.
Testing pop-pressure, seat tightness, and reset pressure of safety relief valves on calibrated test benches before field installation.
Connecting flexible diaphragm or grid couplings between motor shafts and equipment drive shafts.
Temporary conical witch-hat or basket strainer installation and cleaning before commissioning runs.
Guyed or derrick-supported elevated structural flare stack erection with sonic flare tip and ignition pilots.
Casting and curing dense high-alumina refractory and ceramic fiber insulation inside process fired heaters.

electrical.definition: Placing main step-down transformers, dressing bushings and conservator tanks, followed by high-vacuum dielectric oil filtration and BDV tests.
Erecting 33kV/11kV/6.6kV High Tension and 415V Low Tension indoor switchgear panels over substation basement trenches.
Floor-mounted assembly of motor starters, soft starters, variable frequency drives, and circuit breakers controlling plant electric motors.
Installing galvanized perforated, ladder-type, or wire-mesh cable trays and unistrut brackets along process corridors.
Pulling heavy Armoured Copper/Aluminium HT (11kV/33kV) and LT power cables through trenches, ducts, and elevated trays.
Fitting double-compression explosion-proof cable glands and crimping terminal lugs with heat-shrinkable stress sleeves.
Applying DC test voltage (500V/1kV/5kV) across conductors and ground to measure insulation resistance before and after cable laying.
Burying bare copper/GI grounding conductors, welding exothermic cadweld joints, and testing earth pit resistance to ensure under 1 Ohm.
Installing enclosed sandwich copper/aluminium busbars interconnecting power transformers with indoor switchgear rooms.
Erecting industrial dual-redundant static inverter/rectifier cubicles and mounting 110V/220V lead-acid or VRLA battery racks.
Testing emergency diesel generator start sequences, auto-mains-failure (AMF) changeover, and load bank capacity trials.
Assembling compact high-voltage SF6 gas-insulated substation circuit breakers, disconnectors, and instrument transformers.
Resistance grounding unit limiting fault current in transformer neutral systems to protect equipment.
Regulated DC power supply unit delivering impressed current for pipeline corrosion protection.
30-meter polygonal galvanized high mast tower with motorized raising/lowering luminaire head.
Surge generator and time-domain reflectometer testing to pinpoint underground cable faults.

instrumentation.definition: Mounting smart pressure/differential transmitters, impulse line 5-valve manifolds, and 5-point calibration against deadweight testers.
Welding or flanging drilled bar-stock thermowells onto process lines and inserting duplex Pt100 RTD sensors or thermocouples.
In-line alignment and flanging of Coriolis mass flow meters, vortex shedding meters, and electromagnetic flow sensors.
Calibrating smart electro-pneumatic positioners (4-20mA HART) and testing 0-25-50-75-100% travel stroking speed and fail-action.
Ferruling and dressing multi-pair signal cables onto terminal strips inside explosion-proof Ex-d/Ex-e junction boxes.
Bending, routing, and ferrule swaging of 1/2-inch SS316 seamless impulse tubes followed by hydrostatic leak checks.
End-to-end signal validation from field transmitter sensor terminals through marshalling cabinets to DCS operator console graphics.
Simulating trip interlocks and verifying Safety Instrumented Systems (SIL rated) response to initiate emergency blowdown.
Installing and bump-testing optical flame detectors (UV/IR), catalytic bead combustible gas detectors, and toxic H2S sensors.
Installing solar-powered Remote Terminal Units (RTUs) and Modbus/OPC telemetry along pipeline sectionalizing valve stations.
Non-contact high-frequency FMCW radar gauge mounted on tank roof for custody transfer inventory gauging.
Electrically actuated pilot valve venting pneumatic pressure to trigger fail-safe ESD actuator closure.
Testing H1 digital fieldbus communication voltage, waveform quality, and segment terminator resistance.
Heated sample extraction probe, conditioning panel, and continuous emissions analyzer shelter integration.

hse.definition: Formal authorization procedure issuing Hot Work, Cold Work, Confined Space Entry, and Radiography permits with mandatory hazard signoffs.
Daily pre-shift site safety briefing conducted by supervisors discussing task risks, weather conditions, and required PPE.
Step-by-step task risk assessment documenting potential hazards and control barriers prior to executing non-routine operations.
Atmospheric monitoring using multi-gas detectors to confirm 0% LEL, 20.9% O2, and zero toxic gases before entering tanks or hot work.
Applying physical safety padlocks and danger tags to circuit breakers, valves, and switches to prevent accidental re-energization.
Structural inspection of erected tubular scaffolding, base jacks, and toe boards with Green (Safe) or Red (Unsafe) Scafftag display.
Testing jockey pumps, main diesel fire pumps, ring main pressure, monitor flow rate, and deluge valve actuation.
Documenting unsafe conditions, unsafe acts, or unplanned occurrences that did not cause injury but had the potential to do so.
Full body safety harness with double shock-absorbing lanyards anchored to certified lifelines.
Structured multidisciplinary team review identifying process deviation hazards and safeguard adequacy.
Addressable central fire alarm panel monitoring manual call points, hooters, and optical beam detectors.
